📌 नियम: a/an का चुनाव अक्षर (letter) से नहीं, उच्चारण की पहली ध्वनि (sound) से होता है — vowel sound से पहले "an"। उदाहरण: an apple, an umbrella, an hour।
✖ "the" किसी निश्चित/पहले से ज्ञात वस्तु या व्यक्ति के लिए है; यहाँ अनिश्चित (कोई एक) की बात है। "a" consonant sound से पहले आता है — "actor" vowel sound से शुरू है। Singular countable noun अकेला नहीं आता — article ज़रूरी है।
expe:
✔ "actor" begins with the vowel sound /æ/ ("ac-"), so "an" is used: Divya wants to become an actor. After "wants to become", a profession/post is a singular countable noun, so it takes a/an.
📌 Rule: a/an depends on the first SOUND, not the letter — "an" before a vowel sound. Examples: an apple, an umbrella, an hour.
✖ "the" marks something specific/already known; here the noun is indefinite (any one). "a" is used before a consonant sound — "actor" begins with a vowel sound. A singular countable noun cannot stand without an article here.

q: Fill in the blank: Meena will meet us ___ Tuesday.

✖ "in" महीना/वर्ष/दिन के भाग या किसी चीज़ के अंदर के लिए (in May, in the room)। "since" किसी समय-बिंदु से (perfect tense के साथ): since 2010। "at" निश्चित समय/बिंदु-स्थान के लिए (at 5 pm, at the gate)।
expe:
✔ Days of the week take "on". Correct sentence: Meena will meet us on Tuesday.
📌 Prepositions of time: at + clock time (at 5 o'clock), on + day/date (on Monday, on 15 August), in + month/year/season (in May, in 2020).
✖ "in" is for months/years/parts of the day or inside something (in May, in the room). "since" marks a starting point of time, with perfect tenses: since 2010. "at" is for an exact time or point (at 5 pm, at the gate).

q: Fill in the blank: What ___ unique idea it is!
exp:
✔ "unique" अक्षर vowel से शुरू होता है, पर उच्चारण "यूनीक" consonant sound "य" (/j/) से है, इसलिए "a" लगेगा: What a unique idea it is! विस्मयादिबोधक (exclamatory) वाक्य: "What + a/an + adjective + singular noun!" — जैसे What a beautiful day!
📌 u/eu से शुरू होने वाले जिन शब्दों का उच्चारण "यू" (y consonant sound) से होता है, उनसे पहले "a": a university, a uniform, a European, a ewe। पर an umbrella, an uncle (vowel sound)।
✖ "the" किसी निश्चित/पहले से ज्ञात वस्तु या व्यक्ति के लिए है; यहाँ अनिश्चित (कोई एक) की बात है। Singular countable noun अकेला नहीं आता — article ज़रूरी है। "an" vowel sound से पहले आता है — "unique" का उच्चारण consonant sound से है।
expe:
✔ Though "unique" starts with a vowel letter, it is pronounced "yoo-neek", beginning with the consonant sound /j/, so "a" is used: What a unique idea it is! Exclamatory pattern: "What + a/an + adjective + singular noun!" — e.g. What a beautiful day!
📌 Words beginning with u/eu pronounced "yoo" start with the consonant sound /j/, so they take "a": a university, a uniform, a European, a ewe. But an umbrella, an uncle (vowel sound).
✖ "the" marks something specific/already known; here the noun is indefinite (any one). A singular countable noun cannot stand without an article here. "an" is used before a vowel sound — "unique" begins with a consonant sound.

q: Fill in the blank: My brother is proud ___ his son.
exp:
✔ "proud of" — किसी पर गर्व होना। सही वाक्य: My brother is proud of his son.
📌 अन्य "of" वाले: fond of, afraid of, aware of, jealous of, full of, tired of।
✖ "on" दिन/तारीख या सतह के लिए (on Monday, on the table)। "for" उद्देश्य या अवधि के लिए (for you, for two hours)। "with" साथ/साधन के लिए (cut with a knife; pleased with)।
expe:
✔ "proud of" — to feel pride in someone or something. Correct sentence: My brother is proud of his son.
📌 Other "of" collocations: fond of, afraid of, aware of, jealous of, full of, tired of.
✖ "on" is for days/dates or a surface (on Monday, on the table). "for" shows purpose or duration (for you, for two hours). "with" shows accompaniment/instrument (cut with a knife; pleased with).

q: Fill in the blank: Rekha was reading a book ___ I was watching TV.
exp:
✔ "while" — जब दो काम एक ही समय पर (साथ-साथ) चल रहे हों। सही वाक्य: Rekha was reading a book while I was watching TV.
📌 while के साथ प्रायः continuous tense आता है: I was cooking while he was reading।
✖ "lest" = ऐसा न हो कि (lest + should): Work hard lest you should fail। "so that" उद्देश्य (purpose) बताता है। "unless" = यदि नहीं (if not)।
expe:
✔ "while" joins two actions happening at the same time. Correct sentence: Rekha was reading a book while I was watching TV.
📌 "while" is commonly used with continuous tenses: I was cooking while he was reading.
✖ "lest" means "for fear that" (lest + should): Work hard lest you should fail. "so that" expresses purpose. "unless" means "if not".

q: Fill in the blank: Sanjay reaches the office ___ ten o'clock.
exp:
✔ घड़ी के निश्चित समय (clock time) से पहले "at" लगता है। सही वाक्य: Sanjay reaches the office at ten o'clock.
📌 at 10 o'clock, at 5:30 pm, at sunrise; on + दिन/तारीख; in + महीना/वर्ष।
✖ "on" दिन/तारीख या सतह के लिए (on Monday, on the table)। "since" किसी समय-बिंदु से (perfect tense के साथ): since 2010। "in" महीना/वर्ष/दिन के भाग या किसी चीज़ के अंदर के लिए (in May, in the room)।
expe:
✔ An exact clock time takes "at". Correct sentence: Sanjay reaches the office at ten o'clock.
📌 at 10 o'clock, at 5:30 pm, at sunrise; on + day/date; in + month/year.
✖ "on" is for days/dates or a surface (on Monday, on the table). "since" marks a starting point of time, with perfect tenses: since 2010. "in" is for months/years/parts of the day or inside something (in May, in the room).

q: Fill in the blank: Sanjay is rich, ___ he is not proud.
exp:
✔ "but" विरोध (contrast) बताता है — दूसरा भाग पहले भाग से अपेक्षित बात के उलट है। सही वाक्य: Sanjay is rich, but he is not proud.
📌 विरोध के अन्य connectors: yet, still, however, although (although के साथ "but" नहीं लगाते)।
✖ "so" परिणाम (result) बताता है। "or" विकल्प (choice) या "वरना" के अर्थ में आता है। "because" कारण (reason) बताता है।
expe:
✔ "but" shows contrast — the second clause is contrary to what the first leads us to expect. Correct sentence: Sanjay is rich, but he is not proud.
📌 Other contrast connectors: yet, still, however, although (never use "but" together with "although").
✖ "so" introduces a result. "or" shows a choice, or means "otherwise". "because" introduces a reason.

✔ "actor" (ऐक्टर) vowel sound से शुरू होता है, इसलिए "an" लगेगा: Lata wants to become an actor. "wants to become" के बाद पेशा/पद (profession) बताने वाले singular countable noun से पहले a/an आता है।
📌 नियम: a/an का चुनाव अक्षर (letter) से नहीं, उच्चारण की पहली ध्वनि (sound) से होता है — vowel sound से पहले "an"। उदाहरण: an apple, an umbrella, an hour।
✖ Singular countable noun अकेला नहीं आता — article ज़रूरी है। "the" किसी निश्चित/पहले से ज्ञात वस्तु या व्यक्ति के लिए है; यहाँ अनिश्चित (कोई एक) की बात है। "a" consonant sound से पहले आता है — "actor" vowel sound से शुरू है।
expe:
✔ "actor" begins with the vowel sound /æ/ ("ac-"), so "an" is used: Lata wants to become an actor. After "wants to become", a profession/post is a singular countable noun, so it takes a/an.
📌 Rule: a/an depends on the first SOUND, not the letter — "an" before a vowel sound. Examples: an apple, an umbrella, an hour.
✖ A singular countable noun cannot stand without an article here. "the" marks something specific/already known; here the noun is indefinite (any one). "a" is used before a consonant sound — "actor" begins with a vowel sound.

q: Fill in the blank: Rakesh likes to read ___ night.
exp:
✔ "at night" निश्चित मुहावरा (fixed expression) है — रात के लिए "at" लगता है। सही वाक्य: Rakesh likes to read at night.
📌 तुलना करें: in the morning, in the evening, पर at night, at noon, at midnight।
✖ "for" उद्देश्य या अवधि के लिए (for you, for two hours)। "on" दिन/तारीख या सतह के लिए (on Monday, on the table)। "in" महीना/वर्ष/दिन के भाग या किसी चीज़ के अंदर के लिए (in May, in the room)।
expe:
✔ "at night" is a fixed expression — "at" is used with night. Correct sentence: Rakesh likes to read at night.
📌 Compare: in the morning, in the evening, but at night, at noon, at midnight.
✖ "for" shows purpose or duration (for you, for two hours). "on" is for days/dates or a surface (on Monday, on the table). "in" is for months/years/parts of the day or inside something (in May, in the room).

exp:

✖ "by" shows means/agent or a deadline (by bus, by Monday). "in" is for months/years/parts of the day or inside something (in May, in the room). "with" shows accompaniment/instrument (cut with a knife; pleased with).

✖ "for" shows purpose or duration (for you, for two hours). "at" is for an exact time or point (at 5 pm, at the gate). "on" is for days/dates or a surface (on Monday, on the table).

✔ "honest" में "h" silent है — उच्चारण "ऑनेस्ट" vowel sound से शुरू होता है, इसलिए "an" लगेगा: What an honest officer he is! विस्मयादिबोधक (exclamatory) वाक्य: "What + a/an + adjective + singular noun!" — जैसे What a beautiful day!
📌 Silent "h" वाले शब्द vowel sound से शुरू होते हैं, इसलिए "an": an hour, an honest man, an heir, an honour। पर जहाँ h बोला जाता है वहाँ "a": a house, a hospital।
✖ "a" consonant sound से पहले आता है — "honest" vowel sound से शुरू है। "the" किसी निश्चित/पहले से ज्ञात वस्तु या व्यक्ति के लिए है; यहाँ अनिश्चित (कोई एक) की बात है। Singular countable noun अकेला नहीं आता — article ज़रूरी है।
expe:
✔ The "h" in "honest" is silent — it is pronounced "on-est" (h silent), beginning with a vowel sound, so "an" is used: What an honest officer he is! Exclamatory pattern: "What + a/an + adjective + singular noun!" — e.g. What a beautiful day!
📌 Words with a silent "h" begin with a vowel sound, so they take "an": an hour, an honest man, an heir, an honour. Where h is pronounced, use "a": a house, a hospital.
✖ "a" is used before a consonant sound — "honest" begins with a vowel sound. "the" marks something specific/already known; here the noun is indefinite (any one). A singular countable noun cannot stand without an article here.

✖ Singular countable noun अकेला नहीं आता — article ज़रूरी है। "the" किसी निश्चित/पहले से ज्ञात वस्तु या व्यक्ति के लिए है; यहाँ अनिश्चित (कोई एक) की बात है। "an" vowel sound से पहले आता है — "university" का उच्चारण consonant sound से है।
expe:
✔ Though "university" starts with a vowel letter, it is pronounced "yoo-niversity", beginning with the consonant sound /j/, so "a" is used: There is a university near the station. After "There is/was", an unspecified singular countable noun takes a/an.
📌 Words beginning with u/eu pronounced "yoo" start with the consonant sound /j/, so they take "a": a university, a uniform, a European, a ewe. But an umbrella, an uncle (vowel sound).
✖ A singular countable noun cannot stand without an article here. "the" marks something specific/already known; here the noun is indefinite (any one). "an" is used before a vowel sound — "university" begins with a consonant sound.

q: Fill in the blank: We crossed ___ Krishna by boat.
exp:
✔ नदियों (rivers) के नाम से पहले "the" लगता है — We crossed the Krishna by boat. (कृष्णा दक्षिण भारत की एक प्रमुख नदी है)।
📌 "the" इनके साथ: नदियाँ (the Ganga, the Narmada), समुद्र/महासागर (the Indian Ocean), पर्वत-श्रेणियाँ (the Himalayas), धर्मग्रंथ (the Gita)। पर अकेले पर्वत/झील के साथ नहीं: Mount Everest।
✖ यहाँ "the" छोड़ना गलत है — इस तरह के नाम के साथ "the" अनिवार्य है। "a" अनिश्चित एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा के लिए है; proper noun के साथ यह नहीं लगता। "an" अनिश्चित एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा के लिए है; proper noun के साथ यह नहीं लगता।
expe:
✔ Names of rivers take "the" — We crossed the Krishna by boat. (the Krishna is a major river of southern India).
📌 "the" is used with rivers (the Ganga, the Narmada), seas/oceans (the Indian Ocean), mountain ranges (the Himalayas), holy books (the Gita). Not with single peaks: Mount Everest.
✖ Omitting "the" is wrong — this kind of name always takes "the". "a" is for an indefinite singular countable noun; it is not used with this proper noun. "an" is for an indefinite singular countable noun; it is not used with this proper noun.

q: Fill in the blank: The farmer relies ___ his friends.
exp:
✔ "rely on/upon" — किसी पर निर्भर/भरोसा करना। सही वाक्य: The farmer relies on his friends.
📌 इसी तरह: depend on, count on, insist on।
✖ "with" साथ/साधन के लिए (cut with a knife; pleased with)। "from" आरंभ-बिंदु/स्रोत के लिए (from Delhi; different from)। "at" निश्चित समय/बिंदु-स्थान के लिए (at 5 pm, at the gate)।
expe:
✔ "rely on/upon" — to depend on or trust someone. Correct sentence: The farmer relies on his friends.
📌 Similarly: depend on, count on, insist on.
✖ "with" shows accompaniment/instrument (cut with a knife; pleased with). "from" shows origin/source (from Delhi; different from). "at" is for an exact time or point (at 5 pm, at the gate).

q: Fill in the blank: I do not know whether Mohan will come ___ not.
exp:
✔ "whether ... or not" युग्मित (correlative) संयोजक है। सही वाक्य: I do not know whether Mohan will come or not.
📌 Correlative pairs: either ... or, neither ... nor, both ... and, not only ... but also, whether ... or।
✖ "and" दो समान बातों को जोड़ता है (addition)। "but" विरोध (contrast) बताता है। "nor" केवल neither के साथ या नकारात्मक वाक्य में आता है।
expe:
✔ "whether ... or not" is a correlative pair. Correct sentence: I do not know whether Mohan will come or not.
📌 Correlative pairs: either ... or, neither ... nor, both ... and, not only ... but also, whether ... or.
✖ "and" joins similar ideas (addition). "but" shows contrast. "nor" is used with "neither" or after a negative.

q: Fill in the blank: The farmer ran fast ___ he could not catch the bus.
exp:
✔ "but" विरोध (contrast) बताता है — तेज़ दौड़ा, फिर भी बस नहीं पकड़ सका/सकी। सही वाक्य: The farmer ran fast but he could not catch the bus.
📌 विरोध के अन्य connectors: yet, still, however, although (although के साथ "but" नहीं लगाते)।
✖ "so" परिणाम (result) बताता है। "because" कारण (reason) बताता है। "and so" भी परिणाम (result) बताता है, विरोध नहीं।
expe:
✔ "but" shows contrast — he/she ran fast, yet could not catch the bus. Correct sentence: The farmer ran fast but he could not catch the bus.
📌 Other contrast connectors: yet, still, however, although (never use "but" together with "although").
✖ "so" introduces a result. "because" introduces a reason. "and so" also shows a result, not contrast.

q: Fill in the blank: Vijay reads ___ Mahabharata every morning.
exp:
✔ धर्मग्रंथों/पवित्र ग्रंथों (holy books) के नाम से पहले "the" लगता है — Vijay reads the Mahabharata every morning.
📌 उदाहरण: the Ramayana, the Gita, the Bible, the Quran, the Vedas। इसी तरह नदियों (the Ganga) और महासागरों (the Pacific) के साथ भी "the"।
✖ "a" अनिश्चित एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा के लिए है; proper noun के साथ यह नहीं लगता। "an" अनिश्चित एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा के लिए है; proper noun के साथ यह नहीं लगता। यहाँ "the" छोड़ना गलत है — इस तरह के नाम के साथ "the" अनिवार्य है।
expe:
✔ Names of holy books/epics take "the" — Vijay reads the Mahabharata every morning.
📌 Examples: the Ramayana, the Gita, the Bible, the Quran, the Vedas. Rivers (the Ganga) and oceans (the Pacific) also take "the".
✖ "a" is for an indefinite singular countable noun; it is not used with this proper noun. "an" is for an indefinite singular countable noun; it is not used with this proper noun. Omitting "the" is wrong — this kind of name always takes "the".

q: Fill in the blank: He is aware ___ the danger.
exp:
✔ "aware of" — किसी बात से अवगत होना। सही वाक्य: He is aware of the danger.
📌 इसी तरह "of": conscious of, afraid of, fond of, proud of।
✖ "for" उद्देश्य या अवधि के लिए (for you, for two hours)। "from" आरंभ-बिंदु/स्रोत के लिए (from Delhi; different from)। "with" साथ/साधन के लिए (cut with a knife; pleased with)।
expe:
✔ "aware of" — having knowledge of something. Correct sentence: He is aware of the danger.
📌 Similarly with "of": conscious of, afraid of, fond of, proud of.
✖ "for" shows purpose or duration (for you, for two hours). "from" shows origin/source (from Delhi; different from). "with" shows accompaniment/instrument (cut with a knife; pleased with).

q: Fill in the blank: Both Kishore ___ Nisha are teachers.
exp:
✔ "Both ... and" युग्मित (correlative) संयोजक है — दोनों। सही वाक्य: Both Kishore and Nisha are teachers.
📌 Both A and B के साथ verb बहुवचन (plural) होती है: Both Ram and Shyam are teachers। "Both ... as well as" गलत है।
✖ "nor" केवल neither के साथ या नकारात्मक वाक्य में आता है। "or" विकल्प (choice) या "वरना" के अर्थ में आता है। "as well as" "both" के साथ नहीं आता; अलग से "के साथ-साथ" अर्थ में आता है।
expe:
✔ "Both ... and" is a correlative pair meaning the two together. Correct sentence: Both Kishore and Nisha are teachers.
📌 "Both A and B" takes a plural verb: Both Ram and Shyam are teachers. "Both ... as well as" is incorrect.
✖ "nor" is used with "neither" or after a negative. "or" shows a choice, or means "otherwise". "as well as" is not paired with "both"; it means "in addition to" on its own.

q: Fill in the blank: Gopal spoke slowly so ___ everyone could understand.
exp:
✔ "so that" उद्देश्य (purpose) बताता है — ताकि सब समझ सकें। सही वाक्य: Gopal spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.
📌 so that के बाद प्रायः may/might/can/could आते हैं: He works hard so that he may succeed।
✖ "if" शर्त (condition) बताता है। "as" समानता की तुलना (as ... as) या "क्योंकि" अर्थ में। "than" comparative degree के बाद तुलना में आता है (taller than)।
expe:
✔ "so that" expresses purpose — in order that everyone could understand. Correct sentence: Gopal spoke slowly so that everyone could understand.
📌 "so that" is usually followed by may/might/can/could: He works hard so that he may succeed.
✖ "if" introduces a condition. "as" is used in equal comparison (as ... as) or meaning "because". "than" follows a comparative (taller than).

q: Fill in the blank: Meena speaks ___ Gujarati fluently.
exp:
✔ भाषाओं (languages) के नाम से पहले कोई article नहीं लगता — Meena speaks Gujarati fluently.
📌 पर "language" शब्द साथ हो तो "the": the Gujarati language। इसी तरह खेल (play cricket) और विषय (study history) के साथ भी article नहीं।
✖ "an" singular countable common noun के लिए है; भाषा के नाम के साथ नहीं। "a" singular countable common noun के लिए है; भाषा के नाम के साथ नहीं। "the" भाषा के नाम के साथ सामान्यतः नहीं लगता।
expe:
✔ Names of languages take no article — Meena speaks Gujarati fluently.
📌 But with the word "language" use "the": the Gujarati language. Likewise games (play cricket) and subjects (study history) take no article.
✖ "an" is for a singular countable common noun, not a language name. "a" is for a singular countable common noun, not a language name. "the" is not normally used with a language name.

q: Fill in the blank: Meena is tired ___ waiting.
exp:
✔ "tired of" — किसी बात से ऊब जाना/तंग आ जाना। सही वाक्य: Meena is tired of waiting.
📌 "tired of" (ऊब) के साथ प्रायः V-ing: tired of waiting। "sick of" का भी यही अर्थ है।
✖ "from" आरंभ-बिंदु/स्रोत के लिए (from Delhi; different from)। "for" उद्देश्य या अवधि के लिए (for you, for two hours)। "at" निश्चित समय/बिंदु-स्थान के लिए (at 5 pm, at the gate)।
expe:
✔ "tired of" — bored or fed up with something. Correct sentence: Meena is tired of waiting.
📌 "tired of" (fed up) is often followed by V-ing: tired of waiting. "sick of" has the same meaning.
✖ "from" shows origin/source (from Delhi; different from). "for" shows purpose or duration (for you, for two hours). "at" is for an exact time or point (at 5 pm, at the gate).

q: Fill in the blank: I do not know whether Suresh will come ___ not.
exp:
✔ "whether ... or not" युग्मित (correlative) संयोजक है। सही वाक्य: I do not know whether Suresh will come or not.
📌 Correlative pairs: either ... or, neither ... nor, both ... and, not only ... but also, whether ... or।
✖ "and" दो समान बातों को जोड़ता है (addition)। "but" विरोध (contrast) बताता है। "nor" केवल neither के साथ या नकारात्मक वाक्य में आता है।
expe:
✔ "whether ... or not" is a correlative pair. Correct sentence: I do not know whether Suresh will come or not.
📌 Correlative pairs: either ... or, neither ... nor, both ... and, not only ... but also, whether ... or.
✖ "and" joins similar ideas (addition). "but" shows contrast. "nor" is used with "neither" or after a negative.

q: Fill in the blank: Answer the question ___ you leave the room.
exp:
✔ "before" — किसी काम से पहले; कमरा छोड़ने से पहले उत्तर दो। सही वाक्य: Answer the question before you leave the room.
📌 Time clause में future नहीं: before you leave (before you will leave गलत)। विपरीत: after।
✖ "lest" = ऐसा न हो कि (lest + should): Work hard lest you should fail। "since" किसी समय-बिंदु से (perfect tense के साथ): since 2010। "unless" = यदि नहीं (if not)।
expe:
✔ "before" — earlier than another action; answer first, then leave the room. Correct sentence: Answer the question before you leave the room.
📌 A time clause does not take "will": before you leave (not "before you will leave"). Opposite: after.
✖ "lest" means "for fear that" (lest + should): Work hard lest you should fail. "since" marks a starting point of time, with perfect tenses: since 2010. "unless" means "if not".

q: Fill in the blank: Ramesh plays ___ volleyball every evening.
exp:
✔ खेलों (games/sports) के नाम से पहले कोई article नहीं लगता — Ramesh plays volleyball every evening.
📌 उदाहरण: play cricket, play chess, play hockey। पर वाद्य-यंत्रों के साथ "the": play the guitar, play the flute।
✖ "a" singular countable common noun के लिए है; खेल के नाम के साथ नहीं। "the" खेल के नाम के साथ सामान्यतः नहीं लगता। "an" singular countable common noun के लिए है; खेल के नाम के साथ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of games/sports take no article — Ramesh plays volleyball every evening.
📌 Examples: play cricket, play chess, play hockey. But musical instruments take "the": play the guitar, play the flute.
✖ "a" is for a singular countable common noun, not a game name. "the" is not normally used with a game name. "an" is for a singular countable common noun, not a game name.

q: Fill in the blank: Vijay is responsible ___ this mistake.
exp:
✔ "responsible for" — किसी काम/गलती के लिए ज़िम्मेदार। सही वाक्य: Vijay is responsible for this mistake.
📌 पर व्यक्ति के प्रति ज़िम्मेदारी के लिए "to": responsible to the manager।
✖ "on" दिन/तारीख या सतह के लिए (on Monday, on the table)। "of" संबंध/अंश के लिए (a cup of tea; fond of, proud of)। "at" निश्चित समय/बिंदु-स्थान के लिए (at 5 pm, at the gate)।
expe:
✔ "responsible for" — accountable for something. Correct sentence: Vijay is responsible for this mistake.
📌 But accountability to a person takes "to": responsible to the manager.
✖ "on" is for days/dates or a surface (on Monday, on the table). "of" shows relation/part (a cup of tea; fond of, proud of). "at" is for an exact time or point (at 5 pm, at the gate).

q: Fill in the blank: Usha is so weak ___ she cannot walk.
exp:
✔ "so + adjective + that" — इतना ... कि (परिणाम)। सही वाक्य: Usha is so weak that she cannot walk.
📌 इसे "too ... to" से बदला जा सकता है: She is too weak to walk।
✖ "so" परिणाम (result) बताता है। "than" comparative degree के बाद तुलना में आता है (taller than)। "as" समानता की तुलना (as ... as) या "क्योंकि" अर्थ में।
expe:
✔ "so + adjective + that" — so much that (result). Correct sentence: Usha is so weak that she cannot walk.
📌 It can be rewritten with "too ... to": She is too weak to walk.
✖ "so" introduces a result. "than" follows a comparative (taller than). "as" is used in equal comparison (as ... as) or meaning "because".

q: Fill in the blank: ___ Rohan is old, he works hard.
exp:
✔ "Although" विरोध (concession) बताता है — थका/बूढ़ा होने के बावजूद काम करना। सही वाक्य: Although Rohan is old, he works hard.
📌 Although/Though के साथ main clause में "but" नहीं आता; "yet" आ सकता है। noun के साथ "in spite of/despite": in spite of being tired।
✖ "Unless" = यदि नहीं (if not)। "Because" कारण बताता है, विरोध नहीं। "Since" = क्योंकि (कारण) या "तब से"; विरोध नहीं बताता।
expe:
✔ "Although" shows concession — working in spite of being tired/old. Correct sentence: Although Rohan is old, he works hard.
📌 With although/though, do not add "but" in the main clause ("yet" is allowed). Before a noun use "in spite of/despite": in spite of being tired.
✖ "Unless" means "if not". "Because" gives a reason, not contrast. "Since" means "because" or "from a time"; it does not show contrast.

q: Fill in the blank: ___ United States is a large country.
exp:
✔ जिन देशों के नाम में United/Republic/Kingdom जैसे शब्द या बहुवचन रूप हो, उनसे पहले "the" लगता है — The United States is a large country.
📌 उदाहरण: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Maldives, the Philippines। पर सामान्य देश-नाम बिना article: India, Bhutan, Nepal।
✖ "An" अनिश्चित एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा के लिए है; proper noun के साथ यह नहीं लगता। "A" अनिश्चित एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा के लिए है; proper noun के साथ यह नहीं लगता। यहाँ "the" छोड़ना गलत है — इस तरह के नाम के साथ "the" अनिवार्य है।
expe:
✔ Country names containing words like United/Republic/Kingdom, or plural forms, take "the" — The United States is a large country.
📌 Examples: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Maldives, the Philippines. But ordinary country names take no article: India, Bhutan, Nepal.
✖ "An" is for an indefinite singular countable noun; it is not used with this proper noun. "A" is for an indefinite singular countable noun; it is not used with this proper noun. Omitting "the" is wrong — this kind of name always takes "the".

q: Fill in the blank: My father is jealous ___ his neighbour's success.
exp:
✔ "jealous of" — किसी से ईर्ष्या होना। सही वाक्य: My father is jealous of his neighbour's success.
📌 इसी तरह "of": envious of, proud of, fond of, afraid of।
✖ "from" आरंभ-बिंदु/स्रोत के लिए (from Delhi; different from)। "at" निश्चित समय/बिंदु-स्थान के लिए (at 5 pm, at the gate)। "with" साथ/साधन के लिए (cut with a knife; pleased with)।
expe:
✔ "jealous of" — envious of someone or something. Correct sentence: My father is jealous of his neighbour's success.
📌 Similarly with "of": envious of, proud of, fond of, afraid of.
✖ "from" shows origin/source (from Delhi; different from). "at" is for an exact time or point (at 5 pm, at the gate). "with" shows accompaniment/instrument (cut with a knife; pleased with).

q: Fill in the blank: Neither Jyoti ___ Rohan came to the party.
exp:
✔ "Neither ... nor" युग्मित (correlative) संयोजक है — दोनों में से कोई नहीं। सही वाक्य: Neither Jyoti nor Rohan came to the party.
📌 Neither/nor के साथ verb पास वाले subject के अनुसार: Neither he nor I am guilty। Either ... or का प्रयोग भी ऐसा ही है।
✖ "or" विकल्प (choice) या "वरना" के अर्थ में आता है। "but" विरोध (contrast) बताता है। "and" दो समान बातों को जोड़ता है (addition)।
expe:
✔ "Neither ... nor" is a correlative pair meaning not one and not the other. Correct sentence: Neither Jyoti nor Rohan came to the party.
📌 With neither/nor the verb agrees with the nearer subject: Neither he nor I am guilty. Either ... or works the same way.
✖ "or" shows a choice, or means "otherwise". "but" shows contrast. "and" joins similar ideas (addition).

q: Fill in the blank: Jyoti ran fast ___ she could not catch the bus.
exp:
✔ "but" विरोध (contrast) बताता है — तेज़ दौड़ा, फिर भी बस नहीं पकड़ सका/सकी। सही वाक्य: Jyoti ran fast but she could not catch the bus.
📌 विरोध के अन्य connectors: yet, still, however, although (although के साथ "but" नहीं लगाते)।
✖ "and so" भी परिणाम (result) बताता है, विरोध नहीं। "so" परिणाम (result) बताता है। "because" कारण (reason) बताता है।
expe:
✔ "but" shows contrast — he/she ran fast, yet could not catch the bus. Correct sentence: Jyoti ran fast but she could not catch the bus.
📌 Other contrast connectors: yet, still, however, although (never use "but" together with "although").
✖ "and so" also shows a result, not contrast. "so" introduces a result. "because" introduces a reason.

q: Fill in the blank: Usha plays ___ badminton every evening.
exp:
✔ खेलों (games/sports) के नाम से पहले कोई article नहीं लगता — Usha plays badminton every evening.

✖ "a" singular countable common noun के लिए है; खेल के नाम के साथ नहीं। "the" खेल के नाम के साथ सामान्यतः नहीं लगता। "an" singular countable common noun के लिए है; खेल के नाम के साथ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of games/sports take no article — Usha plays badminton every evening.
📌 Examples: play cricket, play chess, play hockey. But musical instruments take "the": play the guitar, play the flute.
✖ "a" is for a singular countable common noun, not a game name. "the" is not normally used with a game name. "an" is for a singular countable common noun, not a game name.

q: Fill in the blank: Asha is similar ___ her brother in looks.
exp:
✔ "similar to" — किसी के समान/मिलता-जुलता। सही वाक्य: Asha is similar to her brother in looks.
📌 इसी तरह "to": equal to, identical to, superior to; पर "different from"।
✖ "from" आरंभ-बिंदु/स्रोत के लिए (from Delhi; different from)। "with" साथ/साधन के लिए (cut with a knife; pleased with)। "as" समानता की तुलना (as ... as) या "क्योंकि" अर्थ में।
expe:
✔ "similar to" — alike or resembling someone/something. Correct sentence: Asha is similar to her brother in looks.
📌 Similarly with "to": equal to, identical to, superior to; but "different from".
✖ "from" shows origin/source (from Delhi; different from). "with" shows accompaniment/instrument (cut with a knife; pleased with). "as" is used in equal comparison (as ... as) or meaning "because".

q: Fill in the blank: Either Lata ___ Sanjay will attend the meeting.
exp:
✔ "Either ... or" युग्मित (correlative) संयोजक है — दोनों में से कोई एक। सही वाक्य: Either Lata or Sanjay will attend the meeting.
📌 Either/or के साथ verb पास वाले subject के अनुसार: Either you or he is right। Neither के साथ nor।
✖ "but" विरोध (contrast) बताता है। "and" दो समान बातों को जोड़ता है (addition)। "nor" केवल neither के साथ या नकारात्मक वाक्य में आता है।
expe:
✔ "Either ... or" is a correlative pair meaning one of the two. Correct sentence: Either Lata or Sanjay will attend the meeting.
📌 With either/or the verb agrees with the nearer subject: Either you or he is right. Neither goes with nor.
✖ "but" shows contrast. "and" joins similar ideas (addition). "nor" is used with "neither" or after a negative.

q: Fill in the blank: I cannot say ___ Anita will agree.
exp:

📌 whether के साथ "or not" जोड़ सकते हैं: whether she will agree or not। doubt, know, ask, wonder के बाद प्रायः whether/if।
✖ "lest" = ऐसा न हो कि (lest + should): Work hard lest you should fail। "though" = यद्यपि (विरोध/concession)। "unless" = यदि नहीं (if not)।
expe:
✔ "whether" expresses doubt/uncertainty — not sure if she will agree. Correct sentence: I cannot say whether Anita will agree.
📌 "or not" can follow: whether she will agree or not. Verbs like doubt, know, ask, wonder are often followed by whether/if.
✖ "lest" means "for fear that" (lest + should): Work hard lest you should fail. "though" means "in spite of the fact that" (concession). "unless" means "if not".

q: Fill in the blank: Rahul has gone to ___ Bhutan.
exp:

expe:

q: Fill in the blank: My uncle spoke ___ behalf of the team.

✔ "on behalf of" — as a representative of; a fixed phrase. Correct sentence: My uncle spoke on behalf of the team.
📌 Example: The minister spoke on behalf of the government. Similarly "in favour of" (in support of).
✖ "by" shows means/agent or a deadline (by bus, by Monday). "for" shows purpose or duration (for you, for two hours). "at" is for an exact time or point (at 5 pm, at the gate).

q: Fill in the blank: Radha apologised ___ the mistake.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'apologise for' है। किसी व्यक्ति से (to) किसी गलती के लिए (for) क्षमा माँगी जाती है — apologise for. सही वाक्य: "Radha apologised for the mistake."
📌 इसी तरह: thank for, blame for, punish for.
✖ of — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'jealous of, aware of' में। on — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'rely on, insist on' में। at — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'good at, look at' में।
expe:

📌 Similar: thank for, blame for, punish for.
✖ of — wrong here; used in e.g. 'jealous of, aware of'. on — wrong here; used in e.g. 'rely on, insist on'. at — wrong here; used in e.g. 'good at, look at'.

q: Fill in the blank: Rohan prefers walking ___ running.
exp:

q: Fill in the blank: Wait here ___ I return.
exp:
✔ 'Till' = जब तक; मेरे लौटने तक यहीं रुको। सही वाक्य: "Wait here till I return."
📌 'Till/until' के बाद negative नहीं आता।
✖ unless — का अर्थ 'यदि नहीं' (शर्त) है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। lest — का अर्थ 'कहीं ऐसा न हो कि' है; इसके बाद 'should' आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। since — कारण या समय-बिंदु ('since Monday') बताता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ 'Till' = up to the time when; wait here until I come back. Correct: "Wait here till I return."
📌 'Till/until' is not followed by a negative ('till I return', not 'till I do not return').
✖ unless — means 'if not' (condition); does not fit here. lest — means 'for fear that'; takes 'should' after it; does not fit here. since — shows reason or a point of time ('since Monday'); does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: Vikas has gone to ___ Japan.

expe:

📌 'The' is used with country names that are plural or contain Republic/Kingdom/States: the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Maldives.
✖ the — only for names like the USA, the UK, the Netherlands. an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here. a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here.

q: Fill in the blank: Suresh ran fast ___ he could not catch the bus.
exp:

expe:

📌 Contrast linkers: but, yet, still, however, although.
✖ because — gives a reason; does not fit here. and so — shows result, not contrast; does not fit here. so — shows result, not contrast; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: My uncle spoke slowly so ___ everyone could understand.
exp:

q: Fill in the blank: Shalini was ___ second to reach the office.
exp:
✔ क्रमसूचक संख्याओं (first, second...) और 'last' से पहले 'the' लगता है। सही वाक्य: "Shalini was the second to reach the office."
📌 Superlative (the tallest) और 'only' (the only son) से पहले भी 'the'।
✖ a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। no article — यहाँ article आवश्यक है। an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Ordinal numbers (first, second...) and 'last' take the definite article 'the'. Correct: "Shalini was the second to reach the office."
📌 Also 'the' with superlatives (the tallest) and 'only' (the only son).
✖ a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. no article — an article is required here. an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here.

q: Fill in the blank: The girl agreed ___ me on this point.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'agree with (person)' है। व्यक्ति के साथ सहमत होने पर 'agree with' आता है। सही वाक्य: "The girl agreed with me on this point."
📌 प्रस्ताव/योजना के लिए 'agree to'; किसी मुद्दे/शर्त पर 'agree on'।
✖ at — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'good at, look at' में। for — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'famous for, eligible for' में। to — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'reply to, prefer to' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'agree with (person)'. We agree WITH a person (share the same opinion). Correct: "The girl agreed with me on this point."
📌 Agree TO a proposal/plan; agree ON a point/term.
✖ at — wrong here; used in e.g. 'good at, look at'. for — wrong here; used in e.g. 'famous for, eligible for'. to — wrong here; used in e.g. 'reply to, prefer to'.

q: Fill in the blank: Either Harish ___ Suresh will attend the meeting.
exp:
✔ Correlative जोड़ा: either ... or (दो में से एक)। सही वाक्य: "Either Harish or Suresh will attend the meeting."
📌 जोड़े: neither...nor, both...and, not only...but also; verb निकटतम subject के अनुसार।
✖ and — समान विचारों को जोड़ता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। but — विरोध (contrast) बताता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। nor — केवल 'neither' के साथ आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ Correlative pair: either ... or (choice between two). Correct: "Either Harish or Suresh will attend the meeting."
📌 Pairs: neither...nor, both...and, not only...but also. Verb agrees with the nearer subject.
✖ and — joins similar ideas (addition); does not fit here. but — shows contrast; does not fit here. nor — pairs only with 'neither'; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: I cannot say ___ Seema will agree.
exp:
✔ 'Cannot say/doubt/ask' के बाद संदेह के लिए 'whether' आता है। सही वाक्य: "I cannot say whether Seema will agree."
📌 'Whether ... or not' भी सही है।
✖ lest — का अर्थ 'कहीं ऐसा न हो कि' है; इसके बाद 'should' आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। unless — का अर्थ 'यदि नहीं' (शर्त) है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। though — विरोध (although) बताता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ 'Whether' introduces doubt/uncertainty after 'cannot say/doubt/ask'. Correct: "I cannot say whether Seema will agree."
📌 'Whether ... or not' is also correct: I cannot say whether she will agree or not.
✖ lest — means 'for fear that'; takes 'should' after it; does not fit here. unless — means 'if not' (condition); does not fit here. though — shows contrast ('although'); does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: Ravi was born in ___ February.
exp:
✔ महीनों और दिनों के नाम से पहले article नहीं लगता: in June, on Monday। सही वाक्य: "Ravi was born in February."
📌 Preposition: in + month/year; on + day/date (on Monday)।
✖ the — सामान्यतः महीने के नाम से पहले नहीं। a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of months (and days) take no article: in June, on Monday. Correct: "Ravi was born in February."
📌 Prepositions: in + month/year (in June, in 1990); on + day/date (on Monday, on 5 June).
✖ the — not used before a month name in general. a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here.

q: Fill in the blank: Geeta is jealous ___ her neighbour's success.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'jealous of' है। 'Jealous' के बाद सदा 'of' आता है। सही वाक्य: "Geeta is jealous of her neighbour's success."
📌 इसी तरह: envious of, proud of, afraid of, fond of.
✖ from — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'suffer from, abstain from' में। at — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'good at, look at' में। with — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'agree with (person), cope with' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'jealous of'. 'Jealous' is always followed by 'of'. Correct: "Geeta is jealous of her neighbour's success."
📌 Similar: envious of, proud of, afraid of, fond of.
✖ from — wrong here; used in e.g. 'suffer from, abstain from'. at — wrong here; used in e.g. 'good at, look at'. with — wrong here; used in e.g. 'agree with (person), cope with'.

q: Fill in the blank: Gopal is not only intelligent ___ hardworking.
exp:
✔ Correlative जोड़ा: not only ... but also। सही वाक्य: "Gopal is not only intelligent but also hardworking."
📌 दोनों भागों के बाद समान part of speech हो (parallelism): intelligent ... hardworking।
✖ and also — 'not only' का सही जोड़ा नहीं है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। and — समान विचारों को जोड़ता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। as well as — 'not only' का जोड़ा नहीं है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ Correlative pair: not only ... but also. Correct: "Gopal is not only intelligent but also hardworking."
📌 Both parts should be followed by the same part of speech (parallelism): intelligent ... hardworking (adjectives).
✖ and also — is not the correlative partner of 'not only'; does not fit here. and — joins similar ideas (addition); does not fit here. as well as — is not the partner of 'not only'; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: ___ Suresh is old, he works hard.
exp:
✔ 'Although' दो उपवाक्यों में विरोध बताता है (बूढ़ा है फिर भी मेहनती)। सही वाक्य: "Although Suresh is old, he works hard."
📌 'although/though' के साथ main clause में 'but' नहीं; 'yet' प्रयोग हो सकता है।
✖ Because — कारण बताता है, विरोध नहीं; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। Since — कारण बताता है, विरोध नहीं; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। Unless — का अर्थ 'यदि नहीं' है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ 'Although' shows contrast between two clauses (old — yet works hard). Correct: "Although Suresh is old, he works hard."
📌 With 'although/though', do not add 'but' in the main clause; 'yet' may be used.
✖ Because — gives a reason, not contrast; does not fit here. Since — gives a reason, not contrast; does not fit here. Unless — means 'if not'; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: Neha was born in ___ June.
exp:
✔ महीनों और दिनों के नाम से पहले article नहीं लगता: in June, on Monday। सही वाक्य: "Neha was born in June."
📌 Preposition: in + month/year; on + day/date (on Monday)।
✖ an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। the — सामान्यतः महीने के नाम से पहले नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of months (and days) take no article: in June, on Monday. Correct: "Neha was born in June."
📌 Prepositions: in + month/year (in June, in 1990); on + day/date (on Monday, on 5 June).
✖ an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here. a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. the — not used before a month name in general.

q: Fill in the blank: Asha was accused ___ theft.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'accused of' है। किसी पर अपराध का आरोप — accuse ... of. सही वाक्य: "Asha was accused of theft."
📌 किंतु: charged WITH (charged with murder)।
✖ with — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'agree with (person), cope with' में। for — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'famous for, eligible for' में। about — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'talk about, think about' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'accused of'. Accuse someone OF a crime/fault. Correct: "Asha was accused of theft."
📌 But: charged WITH a crime (e.g. charged with murder).
✖ with — wrong here; used in e.g. 'agree with (person), cope with'. for — wrong here; used in e.g. 'famous for, eligible for'. about — wrong here; used in e.g. 'talk about, think about'.

q: Fill in the blank: Vikas is so weak ___ he cannot walk.
exp:
✔ संरचना: so + adjective + that (परिणाम): so weak that ... सही वाक्य: "Vikas is so weak that he cannot walk."
📌 इसी तरह: such + (a) noun + that।
✖ than — comparative degree और 'no sooner' के बाद आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। as — 'as...as / so...as' तुलना में आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। so — परिणाम बताता है, विरोध नहीं; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ Structure: so + adjective + that (result): so weak that he cannot walk. Correct: "Vikas is so weak that he cannot walk."
📌 Similar: such + (a) noun + that: such a good speaker that ...
✖ than — is used after comparatives and with 'no sooner'; does not fit here. as — is used in 'as...as / so...as' comparisons; does not fit here. so — shows result, not contrast; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: ___ Ajay is old, he works hard.
exp:
✔ 'Although' दो उपवाक्यों में विरोध बताता है (बूढ़ा है फिर भी मेहनती)। सही वाक्य: "Although Ajay is old, he works hard."
📌 'although/though' के साथ main clause में 'but' नहीं; 'yet' प्रयोग हो सकता है।
✖ Unless — का अर्थ 'यदि नहीं' है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। Since — कारण बताता है, विरोध नहीं; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। Because — कारण बताता है, विरोध नहीं; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ 'Although' shows contrast between two clauses (old — yet works hard). Correct: "Although Ajay is old, he works hard."
📌 With 'although/though', do not add 'but' in the main clause; 'yet' may be used.
✖ Unless — means 'if not'; does not fit here. Since — gives a reason, not contrast; does not fit here. Because — gives a reason, not contrast; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: We saw ___ Amazon from the bridge.
exp:
✔ नदियों के नाम से पहले 'the' लगता है: the Nile, the Yamuna, the Godavari। सही वाक्य: "We saw the Amazon from the bridge."
📌 समुद्र, महासागर, मरुस्थल, पर्वत-श्रेणी के साथ 'the'; अकेली चोटी/झील (Mount Everest) के साथ नहीं।
✖ an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। no article — नदी के नाम के साथ 'the' आवश्यक।
expe:
✔ Names of rivers take 'the': the Nile, the Yamuna, the Son, the Betwa, the Godavari, the Amazon. Correct: "We saw the Amazon from the bridge."
📌 'The' with seas, oceans, deserts, mountain ranges; but not with single peaks or lakes (Mount Everest, Lake Superior).
✖ an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here. a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. no article — river names need 'the'.

q: Fill in the blank: Ramesh is aware ___ the danger.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'aware of' है। 'Aware' (जानकार/सचेत) के बाद 'of' आता है। सही वाक्य: "Ramesh is aware of the danger."
📌 इसी तरह: conscious of, ignorant of, sure of.
✖ from — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'suffer from, abstain from' में। with — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'agree with (person), cope with' में। for — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'famous for, eligible for' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'aware of'. 'Aware' (knowing/conscious) takes 'of'. Correct: "Ramesh is aware of the danger."
📌 Similar: conscious of, ignorant of, sure of.
✖ from — wrong here; used in e.g. 'suffer from, abstain from'. with — wrong here; used in e.g. 'agree with (person), cope with'. for — wrong here; used in e.g. 'famous for, eligible for'.

q: Fill in the blank: Rakesh prefers walking ___ running.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'prefer ... to' है। 'Prefer' के साथ तुलना में 'than' नहीं, 'to' आता है: prefer A to B. सही वाक्य: "Rakesh prefers walking to running."
📌 Latin comparatives भी 'to' लेते हैं: senior to, superior to, inferior to; पर 'would rather ... than'.
✖ from — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'suffer from, abstain from' में। over — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'over the wall, control over' में। than — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'taller than' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'prefer ... to'. 'Prefer' takes 'to' (not 'than') for comparison: prefer A to B. Correct: "Rakesh prefers walking to running."
📌 Also 'to': senior to, junior to, superior to, inferior to. But 'would rather ... than'.
✖ from — wrong here; used in e.g. 'suffer from, abstain from'. over — wrong here; used in e.g. 'over the wall, control over'. than — wrong here; used in e.g. 'taller than'.

q: Fill in the blank: Priya spoke slowly so ___ everyone could understand.
exp:
✔ 'So that' उद्देश्य बताता है: धीरे बोले ताकि सब समझ सकें। सही वाक्य: "Priya spoke slowly so that everyone could understand."
📌 'So that' के बाद can/could/may/might आता है।
✖ if — शर्त बताता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। than — comparative degree और 'no sooner' के बाद आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। as — 'as...as / so...as' तुलना में आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ 'So that' expresses purpose: he spoke slowly so that everyone could understand. Correct: "Priya spoke slowly so that everyone could understand."
📌 'So that' is followed by can/could/may/might.
✖ if — shows condition; does not fit here. than — is used after comparatives and with 'no sooner'; does not fit here. as — is used in 'as...as / so...as' comparisons; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: Camels are used for travel in ___ Thar Desert.
exp:
✔ मरुस्थलों के नाम से पहले 'the': the Thar Desert, the Gobi, the Sahara। सही वाक्य: "Camels are used for travel in the Thar Desert."
📌 नदियों, महासागरों और पर्वत-श्रेणियों (the Himalayas) के साथ भी 'the'।
✖ a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। no article — मरुस्थल के नाम के साथ 'the' आवश्यक।
expe:
✔ Names of deserts take 'the': the Thar Desert, the Gobi Desert, the Sahara. Correct: "Camels are used for travel in the Thar Desert."
📌 'The' also with rivers, oceans and mountain ranges (the Himalayas).
✖ a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here. no article — desert names need 'the'.

q: Fill in the blank: My brother believes ___ hard work.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'believe in' है। किसी सिद्धांत/मूल्य में आस्था के लिए 'believe in' आता है। सही वाक्य: "My brother believes in hard work."
📌 किसी की बात सच मानने पर 'believe someone' (बिना preposition)।
✖ at — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'good at, look at' में। on — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'rely on, insist on' में। with — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'agree with (person), cope with' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'believe in'. 'Believe in' = have faith in an idea or value (hard work). Correct: "My brother believes in hard work."
📌 'Believe someone' = accept what a person says (no preposition).
✖ at — wrong here; used in e.g. 'good at, look at'. on — wrong here; used in e.g. 'rely on, insist on'. with — wrong here; used in e.g. 'agree with (person), cope with'.

q: Fill in the blank: Kavita is so weak ___ she cannot walk.
exp:
✔ संरचना: so + adjective + that (परिणाम): so weak that ... सही वाक्य: "Kavita is so weak that she cannot walk."
📌 इसी तरह: such + (a) noun + that।
✖ as — 'as...as / so...as' तुलना में आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। so — परिणाम बताता है, विरोध नहीं; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। than — comparative degree और 'no sooner' के बाद आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ Structure: so + adjective + that (result): so weak that he cannot walk. Correct: "Kavita is so weak that she cannot walk."
📌 Similar: such + (a) noun + that: such a good speaker that ...
✖ as — is used in 'as...as / so...as' comparisons; does not fit here. so — shows result, not contrast; does not fit here. than — is used after comparatives and with 'no sooner'; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: Pooja speaks ___ Hindi fluently.
exp:
✔ भाषाओं के नाम से पहले article नहीं: speak Hindi/English। सही वाक्य: "Pooja speaks Hindi fluently."
📌 'language' शब्द साथ हो तो 'the' (the Hindi language); लोगों के लिए 'the English'।
✖ a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। the — केवल 'the ... language' या लोगों (the English) के लिए। an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of languages take no article: speak Hindi/English/Sanskrit. Correct: "Pooja speaks Hindi fluently."
📌 'The' is used when 'language' follows (the Hindi language) or for the people (the English = English people).
✖ a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. the — only in 'the ... language' or for a people (the English). an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here.

q: Fill in the blank: Amit is capable ___ doing this work.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'capable of' है। 'Capable' के बाद 'of' + noun/-ing आता है। सही वाक्य: "Amit is capable of doing this work."
📌 किंतु: able TO do; capable OF doing.
✖ in — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'believe in, succeed in' में। for — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'famous for, eligible for' में। at — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'good at, look at' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'capable of'. 'Capable' takes 'of' + noun/-ing. Correct: "Amit is capable of doing this work."
📌 But: able TO do; capable OF doing.
✖ in — wrong here; used in e.g. 'believe in, succeed in'. for — wrong here; used in e.g. 'famous for, eligible for'. at — wrong here; used in e.g. 'good at, look at'.

q: Fill in the blank: Deepak is not only intelligent ___ hardworking.
exp:
✔ Correlative जोड़ा: not only ... but also। सही वाक्य: "Deepak is not only intelligent but also hardworking."
📌 दोनों भागों के बाद समान part of speech हो (parallelism): intelligent ... hardworking।
✖ and — समान विचारों को जोड़ता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। as well as — 'not only' का जोड़ा नहीं है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। and also — 'not only' का सही जोड़ा नहीं है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ Correlative pair: not only ... but also. Correct: "Deepak is not only intelligent but also hardworking."
📌 Both parts should be followed by the same part of speech (parallelism): intelligent ... hardworking (adjectives).
✖ and — joins similar ideas (addition); does not fit here. as well as — is not the partner of 'not only'; does not fit here. and also — is not the correlative partner of 'not only'; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: Rekha speaks ___ Tamil fluently.
exp:
✔ भाषाओं के नाम से पहले article नहीं: speak Hindi/English। सही वाक्य: "Rekha speaks Tamil fluently."
📌 'language' शब्द साथ हो तो 'the' (the Hindi language); लोगों के लिए 'the English'।
✖ a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। the — केवल 'the ... language' या लोगों (the English) के लिए। an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of languages take no article: speak Hindi/English/Sanskrit. Correct: "Rekha speaks Tamil fluently."
📌 'The' is used when 'language' follows (the Hindi language) or for the people (the English = English people).
✖ a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. the — only in 'the ... language' or for a people (the English). an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here.

q: Fill in the blank: My uncle abstains ___ smoking.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'abstain from' है। 'Abstain' (दूर रहना) के बाद 'from' आता है। सही वाक्य: "My uncle abstains from smoking."
📌 इसी तरह: refrain from, desist from, prevent from.
✖ with — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'agree with (person), cope with' में। of — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'jealous of, aware of' में। to — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'reply to, prefer to' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'abstain from'. 'Abstain' (keep oneself away) is followed by 'from'. Correct: "My uncle abstains from smoking."
📌 Similar: refrain from, desist from, prevent from.
✖ with — wrong here; used in e.g. 'agree with (person), cope with'. of — wrong here; used in e.g. 'jealous of, aware of'. to — wrong here; used in e.g. 'reply to, prefer to'.

q: Fill in the blank: Both Vikas ___ Meena are teachers.
exp:
✔ Correlative जोड़ा: both ... and; verb plural (are) होती है। सही वाक्य: "Both Vikas and Meena are teachers."
📌 'Both...as well as' गलत है। अन्य: either...or, neither...nor।
✖ nor — केवल 'neither' के साथ आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। or — 'either' के साथ आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। as well as — 'both ... as well as' गलत है; 'both' का जोड़ा 'and' है।
expe:
✔ Correlative pair: both ... and; the verb is plural (are). Correct: "Both Vikas and Meena are teachers."
📌 'Both...as well as' is wrong. Other pairs: either...or, neither...nor.
✖ nor — pairs only with 'neither'; does not fit here. or — pairs with 'either'; does not fit here. as well as — 'both ... as well as' is incorrect; 'both' pairs with 'and'.

q: Fill in the blank: My brother speaks ___ Hindi fluently.
exp:
✔ भाषाओं के नाम से पहले article नहीं: speak Hindi/English। सही वाक्य: "My brother speaks Hindi fluently."
📌 'language' शब्द साथ हो तो 'the' (the Hindi language); लोगों के लिए 'the English'।
✖ the — केवल 'the ... language' या लोगों (the English) के लिए। an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of languages take no article: speak Hindi/English/Sanskrit. Correct: "My brother speaks Hindi fluently."
📌 'The' is used when 'language' follows (the Hindi language) or for the people (the English = English people).
✖ the — only in 'the ... language' or for a people (the English). an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here. a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here.

q: Fill in the blank: Priya believes ___ hard work.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'believe in' है। किसी सिद्धांत/मूल्य में आस्था के लिए 'believe in' आता है। सही वाक्य: "Priya believes in hard work."
📌 किसी की बात सच मानने पर 'believe someone' (बिना preposition)।
✖ with — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'agree with (person), cope with' में। on — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'rely on, insist on' में। at — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'good at, look at' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'believe in'. 'Believe in' = have faith in an idea or value (hard work). Correct: "Priya believes in hard work."
📌 'Believe someone' = accept what a person says (no preposition).
✖ with — wrong here; used in e.g. 'agree with (person), cope with'. on — wrong here; used in e.g. 'rely on, insist on'. at — wrong here; used in e.g. 'good at, look at'.

q: Fill in the blank: Neither Meena ___ Jyoti came to the party.
exp:
✔ Correlative जोड़ा: neither ... nor (न यह, न वह)। सही वाक्य: "Neither Meena nor Jyoti came to the party."
📌 जोड़े: either...or, both...and, not only...but also।
✖ but — विरोध (contrast) बताता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। and — समान विचारों को जोड़ता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं। or — 'either' के साथ आता है; यहाँ उपयुक्त नहीं।
expe:
✔ Correlative pair: neither ... nor (not one and not the other). Correct: "Neither Meena nor Jyoti came to the party."
📌 Pairs: either...or, both...and, not only...but also.
✖ but — shows contrast; does not fit here. and — joins similar ideas (addition); does not fit here. or — pairs with 'either'; does not fit here.

q: Fill in the blank: Arjun plays ___ football every evening.
exp:
✔ खेलों के नाम से पहले article नहीं: play football, tennis। सही वाक्य: "Arjun plays football every evening."
📌 किंतु वाद्य यंत्रों के साथ 'the': play the guitar, play the flute।
✖ the — वाद्य यंत्रों के साथ, खेलों के साथ नहीं। a — व्यंजन ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं। an — स्वर ध्वनि वाले एकवचन countable noun से पहले; यहाँ नहीं।
expe:
✔ Names of games/sports take no article: play football, tennis, volleyball. Correct: "Arjun plays football every evening."
📌 But musical instruments take 'the': play the guitar, play the flute.
✖ the — used with musical instruments, not games. a — used before a singular countable noun with a consonant sound; not here. an — used before a vowel sound in a singular countable noun; not here.

q: Fill in the blank: Pooja is in charge ___ the office.
exp:
✔ सही collocation 'in charge of' है। Fixed phrase 'in charge of' = किसी का प्रभारी होना। सही वाक्य: "Pooja is in charge of the office."
📌 इसी तरह: in favour of, in spite of, in place of.
✖ on — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'rely on, insist on' में। with — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'agree with (person), cope with' में। for — यहाँ गलत; इसका प्रयोग जैसे 'famous for, eligible for' में।
expe:
✔ The correct collocation is 'in charge of'. Fixed phrase: 'in charge of' = responsible for managing. Correct: "Pooja is in charge of the office."
📌 Similar phrases: in favour of, in spite of, in place of.
✖ on — wrong here; used in e.g. 'rely on, insist on'. with — wrong here; used in e.g. 'agree with (person), cope with'. for — wrong here; used in e.g. 'famous for, eligible for'.
